variant.title: Repeated Neighbours Sudoku
variant.description: Every cell tells whether its orthogonal neighbours contain a repeated digit.
rule.repeated_neighbours_gray: A gray cell has at least one equal pair among its orthogonal neighbours.
rule.repeated_neighbours_white: An unshaded cell has no equal pair among its orthogonal neighbours.
rule_guide.title: Repeated Neighbours Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3x3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: For every gray cell, at least two cells directly above, below, left, or right of it must contain the same digit.
rule_guide.item_3: For every unshaded cell, all cells directly above, below, left, or right of it must contain different digits. The center cell itself is not compared.
